summary: Driver ride lifecycle UI E2E PASSED 100% after the DriverRideFlow.jsx → RideFlowViews.jsx presentational refactor. Zero regression observed. Logged in as jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123!, auto-restored pre-seeded 'accepted' ride, walked through every phase transition (accepted → arrived → in_progress → completion) using the exact data-testids listed in the review request, and confirmed the overlay unmounts back to driver-home-page at the end.
verified_flows: Login /login/email with jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123! → redirected to /chauffeur/home; data-testid='driver-ride-flow' auto-mounts within ~1s (rideAPI.getActive() restore path on DriverHome lines 264-280 works after refactor).

ACCEPTED phase: ride-flow-title='Prendre le passager'; ride-flow-address='Hôtel de Ville, Paris'; all required testids present (ride-flow-menu-btn, ride-flow-sos-btn, ride-flow-call-btn, ride-flow-chat-btn, ride-flow-nav-btn, ride-flow-passenger-card); passenger-card shows 'Test User · 5.40 km · 18 minutes' with stars; slide-arrive rendered.

MENU (3-dot): clicking ride-flow-menu-btn opens ride-flow-menu containing menu-passenger-details ('Voir les détails du passager'), menu-waybill ('Lettre de voiture'), menu-cancel-trip ('Annuler le voyage'). All three are clickable. NOTE: actual label is 'Voir les détails du passager' (full phrase) — the request abbreviated it as 'Détails passager'; this is NOT a regression, the labels are unchanged from pre-refactor.

ARRIVE: slide-arrive activated via pointer drag → title becomes 'EN ROUTE'; ride-flow-video-row + ride-flow-video-checkbox appear; ride-flow-pickup-wait timer mounted on map; slide-start now rendered.

START + OTP: slide-start activated → ride-flow-otp-modal opens. Filled ride-flow-otp-input='1234' (seeded start_otp), clicked ride-flow-otp-verify-btn → title becomes 'COURSE EN COURS'; ride-flow-timer counting; ride-flow-waiting-btn + slide-finish rendered.
BACK BUTTON BLOCKED: page.go_back() during in_progress → URL stays /chauffeur/home and driver-ride-flow overlay remains mounted (popstate guard works after refactor).
WAITING toggle: 1st click → label becomes 'Attente en cours · 00:00:01 · 0.01 €' (amber, charging). 2nd click → label resets to 'Attente'. No crash, no console error.

FINISH: slide-finish activated → extra-charges-screen rendered. Submitted with 0 extras → extra-confirm-yes → status=completed → invoice-screen rendered → collect-payment-btn → rate-passenger-screen → rate-star-5 → rate-submit-btn → ride-complete-success → success-ok-btn → overlay unmounts and driver-home-page is back (counts confirmed).

seed_data_creation: Consumed the pre-seeded 'accepted' ride for jean.dupont by driving it to completion. If the same test needs to be repeated, please re-seed a fresh 'accepted' ride for jean.dupont (start_otp '1234' or any other value the test can read).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor is verified zero-regression. Pre-seeded ride was consumed end-to-end; jean.dupont is now back on driver-home with no active ride. If the next agent needs to retest the ride-flow, ask main agent to re-seed an 'accepted' ride for jean.dupont. To activate a SlideToConfirm in Playwright, the most reliable method is page.mouse.down at the thumb center → page.mouse.move in ~20 steps to the right edge of the track → page.mouse.up (a plain .click on the thumb does NOT trigger fire() because draggingRef requires pointerdown→pointermove). OTP input testid is 'ride-flow-otp-input' (single input, not 4 digits). Menu labels are 'Voir les détails du passager / Lettre de voiture / Annuler le voyage' (testids menu-passenger-details / menu-waybill / menu-cancel-trip).
rca of the issue: No bug. Refactor preserved every testid and behavior identically. Only pseudo-issue was my first test attempt clicking the slider thumb (pure click) which doesn't fire SlideToConfirm.fire() in the current implementation because the component requires a pointer drag (draggingRef + pointermove). Switching to mouse.down/move/up resolved it and the full lifecycle then passed.
